name: dkg-claude-code-memory
description: MCP server providing Claude Code agents with persistent, verifiable Working Memory on OriginTrail DKG v10. Captures research findings, vulnerability analyses, and code reviews with cryptographic provenance for cross-session retrieval and team sharing.

tools.name: capture_research_finding
tools.description: Write an artifact to DKG Working Memory with SHA-256 content hash, timestamp, and agent provenance

tools.name: search_working_memory
tools.description: SPARQL search by keyword, type, status, or session ID

tools.name: get_artifact_content
tools.description: Retrieve full artifact content by UAL or URN reference

tools.name: update_artifact_status
tools.description: Advance an artifact through the trust gradient (draft → needs_sources → review_needed → validated → ready_to_share)

tools.name: promote_to_shared_memory
tools.description: Share validated artifacts with team peers (requires explicit user confirmation)

tools.name: synthesize_session
tools.description: Aggregate all artifacts from a session into a structured knowledge_synthesis artifact

tools.name: get_session_summary
tools.description: List all artifacts from a session with type counts and status breakdown

tools.name: query_shared_memory
tools.description: Query team-shared artifacts across peer sessions for collaborative research
